ei.title: Practice 03 — 결혼준비와 개인적인 일로 인한 자원봉사 활동 중단을 알리기 위해서
ei.subject: 올림포스독해의기본2

fullPassage: Dear Randy: I have greatly enjoyed my work as a literacy volunteer at your center for the past three years. I think I have received as much from the people I have worked with as I have given. It has been a gift to be able to make a difference in the lives of such wonderful people. Unfortunately, though, I will have to suspend my involvement at least for the immediate future. I am getting married this spring, and with the arrangement for that, my full-time job at the hospital, and plans for graduate school, I am overwhelmed. When my life returns to normal, I would love to come back. Thank you for giving me the chance to contribute. Sincerely, Morgan Diamond

questions.passage: Dear Randy: I have greatly [enjoyed / regretted] my work as a literacy volunteer at your center for the past three years. I think I have received as much from the people I have worked with as I have given. It has been a gift to be able to [make a difference / cause trouble] in the lives of such wonderful people. Unfortunately, though, I will have to suspend my involvement at least for the immediate future. I am getting married this spring, and with the arrangement for that, my full-time job at the hospital, and plans for graduate school, I am [overwhelmed / relaxed]. When my life returns to normal, I would love to come back. Thank you for giving me the chance to contribute. Sincerely, Morgan Diamond
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) enjoyed=즐겼다, (B) make a difference=변화를 만들다, (C) overwhelmed=압도된
det.analysis:
❌ ① enjoyed — cause trouble — overwhelmed: (B) cause trouble(문제를 일으키다)은 make a difference(변화를 만들다)와 의미상 부적절
❌ ② regretted — make a difference — overwhelmed: (A) regretted(후회했다)는 enjoyed(즐겼다)의 반의어로 부적절
❌ ③ enjoyed — make a difference — relaxed: (C) relaxed(여유롭다)는 결혼·직장·대학원 준비로 바쁜 맥락에 부적절
✅ ④ enjoyed — make a difference — overwhelmed: 원문 일치. 자원봉사를 즐기며(enjoyed), 변화를 만들 수 있었고(make a difference), 일정이 많아 압도된(overwhelmed) 맥락에 부합
det.tip: enjoyed volunteer work + make a difference in lives + overwhelmed with schedule — 편지의 핵심 흐름

questions.passage: Dear Randy: I have greatly enjoyed my work as a literacy [volunteer / employee] at your center for the past three years. I think I have received as much from the people I have worked with as I have given. It has been a gift to be able to make a difference in the lives of such wonderful people. Unfortunately, though, I will have to [suspend / continue] my involvement at least for the immediate future. I am getting married this spring, and with the arrangement for that, my full-time job at the hospital, and plans for graduate school, I am overwhelmed. When my life returns to normal, I would love to come back. Thank you for giving me the chance to [contribute / withdraw]. Sincerely, Morgan Diamond
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① volunteer — continue — contribute: (B) continue(계속하다)는 suspend(중단하다)의 반의어로, 중단을 알리는 편지 맥락에 부적절
❌ ② employee — suspend — contribute: (A) employee(직원)는 volunteer(자원봉사자)와 의미 다름. 급여를 받는 관계임을 암시해 부적절
✅ ③ volunteer — suspend — contribute: 원문 일치. 자원봉사자로(volunteer), 참여를 중단해야 하며(suspend), 기여 기회에 감사(contribute)
❌ ④ volunteer — suspend — withdraw: (C) withdraw(철회하다)는 contribute(기여하다)와 의미상 반대로 부적절
det.tip: volunteer work + suspend involvement + chance to contribute — 자원봉사 중단 편지의 핵심 3단어

questions.passage: Dear Randy: I have greatly enjoyed my work as a literacy volunteer at your center for the past three years. I think I have [received / given up] as much from the people I have worked with as I have given. It has been a gift to be able to make a difference in the lives of such wonderful people. Unfortunately, though, I will have to suspend my [involvement / absence] at least for the immediate future. I am getting married this spring, and with the [arrangement / cancellation] for that, my full-time job at the hospital, and plans for graduate school, I am overwhelmed. When my life returns to normal, I would love to come back. Thank you for giving me the chance to contribute. Sincerely, Morgan Diamond
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① received — absence — arrangement: (B) absence(부재)는 involvement(참여)와 의미 반대. 중단해야 할 것은 부재가 아닌 참여
❌ ② given up — involvement — arrangement: (A) given up(포기하다)은 received(받았다)와 의미 다름
❌ ③ received — involvement — cancellation: (C) cancellation(취소)은 arrangement(준비/계획)의 반의어로 결혼 준비 맥락에 부적절
✅ ④ received — involvement — arrangement: 원문 일치. 사람들에게 받은 것(received), 참여를 중단(involvement), 결혼 준비(arrangement) 맥락에 부합
det.tip: received as much as given / suspend involvement / arrangement for wedding — 섬세한 어휘 구분 필요

questions.passage: Dear Randy: I have greatly enjoyed my work as a literacy ①<u>volunteer</u> at your center for the past three years. I think I have received as much from the people I have worked with as I have given. It has been a ②<u>gift</u> to be able to make a difference in the lives of such wonderful people. Unfortunately, though, I will have to ③<u>suspend</u> my involvement at least for the immediate future. I am getting married this spring, and with the arrangement for that, my full-time job at the hospital, and plans for graduate school, I am ④<u>composed</u>. When my life returns to normal, I would love to come back. Thank you for giving me the chance to contribute. Sincerely, Morgan Diamond
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: 결혼 준비·직장·대학원 계획으로 바쁜 상황에는 overwhelmed(압도된)가 맞음. composed(침착한)는 부적절
det.analysis:
❌ ① volunteer — 원문 일치. 자원봉사자로 일했다는 맥락에 적절
❌ ② gift — 원문 일치. 좋은 사람들과 함께하는 것이 선물이라는 맥락에 적절
❌ ③ suspend — 원문 일치. 참여를 중단해야 한다는 맥락에 적절
✅ ④ composed — 원문은 overwhelmed(압도된). composed(침착한)는 반대 의미로 부적절
det.tip: I am overwhelmed = 너무 많은 일로 압도됨. composed(침착한, 차분한)로 바꾸면 바쁜 상황 설명과 모순

questions.passage: Dear Randy: I have greatly enjoyed my work as a literacy volunteer at your center for the past three years. I think I have received as much from the people I have worked with as I have given. It has been a gift to be able to ①<u>ignore</u> in the lives of such wonderful people. Unfortunately, though, I will have to suspend my ②<u>involvement</u> at least for the immediate future. I am getting married this spring, and with the ③<u>arrangement</u> for that, my full-time job at the hospital, and plans for graduate school, I am overwhelmed. When my life returns to normal, I would love to come back. Thank you for giving me the chance to ④<u>contribute</u>. Sincerely, Morgan Diamond
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: 멋진 사람들의 삶에 '변화를 만들다'가 맞음. ignore(무시하다)는 부적절
det.analysis:
✅ ① ignore — 원문은 make a difference(변화를 만들다). 멋진 사람들의 삶에서 변화를 만들 수 있는 것이 선물이라는 맥락에 ignore(무시하다)는 전혀 맞지 않음
❌ ② involvement — 원문 일치. 참여를 중단해야 한다는 맥락에 적절
❌ ③ arrangement — 원문 일치. 결혼 준비라는 맥락에 적절
❌ ④ contribute — 원문 일치. 기여할 기회에 감사한다는 맥락에 적절
det.tip: make a difference in the lives = 삶에 변화를 주다. ignore(무시하다)로 바꾸면 의미가 완전히 반전

questions.passage: Dear Randy: I have greatly enjoyed my work as a literacy volunteer at your center for the past three years. I think I have received as much from the people I have worked with as I have given. It has been a gift to be able to make a difference in the lives of such wonderful people. Unfortunately, though, I will have to suspend my involvement at least for the ①<u>immediate</u> future. I am getting married this spring, and with the arrangement for that, my ②<u>part-time</u> job at the hospital, and plans for graduate school, I am overwhelmed. When my life ③<u>returns</u> to normal, I would love to come back. Thank you for giving me the chance to ④<u>contribute</u>. Sincerely, Morgan Diamond
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: 병원 full-time(정규직) 근무가 맞음. part-time(시간제)는 부적절
det.analysis:
❌ ① immediate — 원문 일치. 당장 가까운 미래라는 맥락에 적절
✅ ② part-time — 원문은 full-time(전일제/정규직). 결혼 준비·병원 일·대학원 계획이 모두 겹쳐 압도된 맥락에 full-time이 적절. part-time(시간제)으로 바꾸면 바쁘다는 근거가 약해짐
❌ ③ returns — 원문 일치. 삶이 정상으로 돌아온다는 맥락에 적절
❌ ④ contribute — 원문 일치. 기여할 기회에 감사한다는 맥락에 적절
det.tip: my full-time job at the hospital = 병원 정규직 근무. part-time이면 바쁠 이유가 줄어 맥락과 어긋남

questions.passage: Dear Randy: I have greatly enjoyed my work as a literacy volunteer at your center for the past three years. I think I have received as much from the people I have worked with as I have given. It has been a gift to be able to make a difference in the lives of such wonderful people. Unfortunately, though, I will have to __________ my involvement at least for the immediate future. I am getting married this spring, and with the arrangement for that, my full-time job at the hospital, and plans for graduate school, I am overwhelmed. When my life returns to normal, I would love to come back. Thank you for giving me the chance to contribute. Sincerely, Morgan Diamond
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① suspend — 중단하다. 결혼·직장·대학원 계획으로 바쁜 상황에서 자원봉사 참여를 일시 중단한다는 맥락에 정확히 부합
❌ ② expand — 확대하다. 바쁜 상황에서 참여를 늘린다는 것은 문맥 모순
❌ ③ continue — 계속하다. 편지 전체가 중단을 알리는 내용이므로 부적절
❌ ④ enjoy — 즐기다. 빈칸 앞뒤 '안타깝게도 ~ 적어도 당분간'과 어울리지 않음
det.tip: suspend involvement = 참여를 일시 중단하다. 영구 탈퇴가 아닌 휴식을 뜻함

questions.passage: Dear Randy: I have greatly enjoyed my work as a literacy volunteer at your center for the past three years. I think I have received as much from the people I have worked with as I have given. It has been a gift to be able to make a difference in the lives of such wonderful people. Unfortunately, though, I will have to suspend my involvement at least for the immediate future. I am getting married this spring, and with the __________ for that, my full-time job at the hospital, and plans for graduate school, I am overwhelmed. When my life returns to normal, I would love to come back. Thank you for giving me the chance to contribute. Sincerely, Morgan Diamond
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① involvement — 참여. 결혼을 위한 참여라는 표현은 어색함
✅ ② arrangement — 준비, 계획. 결혼을 위한 준비가 병원 직장·대학원 계획과 함께 압도되는 이유로 자연스럽게 연결
❌ ③ graduation — 졸업. 결혼을 위한 졸업이라는 표현은 맥락에 맞지 않음
❌ ④ suspension — 중단. 결혼을 위한 중단이라는 표현은 어색함
det.tip: arrangement for the wedding = 결혼 준비. 다음에 나오는 직장·대학원 계획과 병렬 구조

questions.passage: Dear Randy: I have greatly enjoyed my work as a literacy __________ at your center for the past three years. I think I have received as much from the people I have worked with as I have given. It has been a gift to be able to make a difference in the lives of such wonderful people. Unfortunately, though, I will have to suspend my involvement at least for the immediate future. I am getting married this spring, and with the arrangement for that, my full-time job at the hospital, and plans for graduate school, I am overwhelmed. When my life returns to normal, I would love to come back. Thank you for giving me the chance to contribute. Sincerely, Morgan Diamond
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① involvement — 참여. 명사이지만 '사람'이 아닌 추상 개념이므로 literacy ___ 자리에 어색함
❌ ② recipient — 수혜자. 봉사를 받는 사람이지 제공하는 사람이 아님
✅ ③ volunteer — 자원봉사자. 센터에서 자발적으로 봉사하는 사람이라는 맥락에 정확히 부합
❌ ④ contributor — 기여자. contribute에서 파생되었지만 문해력 봉사 활동의 역할명으로는 volunteer가 더 적절
det.tip: literacy volunteer = 문해력(읽고 쓰기) 자원봉사자. 학습 지원 센터에서 무급으로 일하는 역할

questions.passage: Dear Randy: I have greatly enjoyed my work as a literacy volunteer at your center for the past three years. I think I have received as much from the people I have worked with as I have given. It has been a gift to be able to make a difference in the lives of such wonderful people. Unfortunately, though, I will have to suspend my involvement at least for the immediate future. I am getting married this spring, and with the arrangement for that, my full-time job at the hospital, and plans for graduate school, I am overwhelmed. When my life returns to normal, I would love to come back. Thank you for giving me the chance to <u>contribute</u>. Sincerely, Morgan Diamond
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 contribute의 의미와 가장 가까운 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① withdraw — 물러나다, 철회하다. contribute의 반의어
❌ ② complain — 불평하다. 전혀 다른 의미
✅ ③ give back — 돌려주다, 기여하다. contribute와 가장 가까운 표현. 자원봉사로 사회에 환원하는 의미
❌ ④ demand — 요구하다. 주는 행위가 아닌 받는 행위를 뜻함
det.tip: contribute ≈ give back — 둘 다 자신의 시간·노력을 사회에 기여하는 의미

questions.passage: Dear Randy: I have greatly enjoyed my work as a literacy volunteer at your center for the past three years. I think I have received as much from the people I have worked with as I have given. It has been a gift to be able to make a difference in the lives of such wonderful people. questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 suspend의 의미와 가장 가까운 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① resume — 재개하다. suspend의 반의어
✅ ② pause — 잠시 멈추다. suspend와 가장 가까운 동의어. 영구 중단이 아닌 일시 중지를 의미
❌ ③ expand — 확대하다. 전혀 반대 의미
❌ ④ celebrate — 기념하다. 전혀 다른 의미
det.tip: suspend ≈ pause ≈ put on hold — 모두 '일시적으로 중단하다'의 의미. terminate(영구 종료)와 구분

questions.passage: Dear Randy: I have greatly enjoyed my work as a literacy volunteer at your center for the past three years. questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 overwhelmed의 의미와 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: overwhelmed = 압도된, 감당 못 하는 → swamped
det.analysis:
❌ ① relieved — 안도한. 압도된 것과 반대 감정
❌ ② bored — 지루한. 너무 많은 일로 지친 것과 다른 의미
✅ ③ swamped — 압도된, 몹시 바쁜. overwhelmed와 가장 가까운 동의어
❌ ④ content — 만족한. 긍정적 감정이므로 부적절
det.tip: overwhelmed ≈ swamped — 둘 다 '너무 많은 것에 압도되어 감당하기 어렵다'는 의미

questions.passage: Dear Randy: I have greatly enjoyed my work as a literacy volunteer at your center for the past three years. questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 suspend의 의미와 가장 먼 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① resume — 재개하다. suspend(중단하다)의 직접적 반의어
❌ ② halt — 중지하다. suspend와 유사한 의미
❌ ③ pause — 잠시 멈추다. suspend와 유사한 의미
❌ ④ discontinue — 중단하다. suspend와 유사한 의미
det.tip: suspend(중단하다) ↔ resume(재개하다). 편지 마지막에 'come back'을 원한다는 표현이 resume의 반대 상황을 나타냄

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 involvement의 의미와 가장 먼 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① participation — 참여. involvement와 유사한 의미
❌ ② engagement — 참여, 관여. involvement와 유사한 의미
❌ ③ commitment — 헌신, 참여. involvement와 유사한 의미
✅ ④ detachment — 분리, 거리 두기, 무관여. involvement(참여/관여)의 반의어
det.tip: involvement(참여) ↔ detachment(거리 두기). 자원봉사에 깊이 관여한 상태와 정반대

questions.passage: The child <u>received</u> a surprise birthday gift from her grandparents and was delighted. She received the package carefully and opened it with excitement. I have greatly enjoyed my work as a literacy volunteer at your center for the past three years. I think I have <u>received</u> as much from the people I have worked with as I have given.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 received가 (A)와 (B)에서 의미하는 것으로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: (A) received = 받았다(물건을 수령), (B) received = 얻었다(무형의 것, 경험/보람 등을 획득)
det.analysis:
❌ ① (A) 수령했다 — (B) 전달했다: (B)는 사람들로부터 받은 것이지 전달이 아님
❌ ② (A) 거절했다 — (B) 얻었다: (A) refused와 혼동. (A)는 선물을 기쁘게 수령한 상황
✅ ③ (A) 수령했다 — (B) 얻었다: (A)는 물리적 물건을 받은 것, (B)는 자원봉사를 통해 무형의 보람/경험을 얻은 것
❌ ④ (A) 기대했다 — (B) 얻었다: (A)는 기대가 아닌 실제 수령 상황
det.tip: receive = (A) 물건·편지 등 유형물 수령 / (B) 경험·보람·영향 등 무형의 것을 얻음

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "a person who freely offers to take part in an enterprise or undertake a task without being paid"

det.korean: 무급으로 자유롭게 활동에 참여하는 사람 → volunteer
det.analysis:
✅ ① volunteer — 자원봉사자. 'without being paid(무급으로)'와 'freely offers(자유롭게)'가 정의의 핵심. 정확히 일치
❌ ② supervisor — 감독관. 역할이 다름. 반드시 무급이 아님
❌ ③ employee — 직원. 급여를 받는 사람이므로 정의와 반대
❌ ④ recipient — 수혜자. 활동을 제공하는 것이 아니라 받는 사람
det.tip: volunteer = 자유로운 의지로(voluntarily) + 무급으로(without pay) 일하는 사람

questions.passage: Unfortunately, though, I will have to __________ (suspend) my involvement at least for the immediate future. When my life returns to normal, I would love to come back.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: 조동사 have to 뒤에 동사원형이 옴 → suspend
det.analysis: have to + 동사원형 구조. will have to suspend가 원문 그대로. 동사원형 유지
det.tip: will have to + 동사원형. to 뒤는 항상 원형

questions.passage: I have greatly enjoyed my work as a literacy volunteer at your center for the past three years. I think I have received as much from the people I have worked with as I have given. It has been a gift to be able to __________ (make) a difference in the lives of such wonderful people.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: to 부정사 구조 'to be able to + 동사원형' → make
det.analysis: be able to + 동사원형 구조. to be able to make가 원문. make 원형 유지
det.tip: to be able to + 동사원형. able to 뒤는 반드시 원형

questions.passage: Dear Randy: I have greatly enjoyed my work as a literacy volunteer at your center for the past three years. I think I have received as much from the people I have worked with as I have given. It has been a gift to be able to make a difference in the lives of such wonderful people. Unfortunately, though, I will have to suspend my involvement at least for the __________. I am getting married this spring, and with the arrangement for that, my full-time job at the hospital, and plans for graduate school, I am overwhelmed. When my life returns to normal, I would love to come back. Thank you for giving me the chance to contribute. Sincerely, Morgan Diamond
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① past three years — 지난 3년. 과거의 기간이지 현재 중단의 기간이 아님
✅ ② immediate future — 가까운 미래, 당분간. 결혼·직장·대학원 준비가 끝날 때까지 일시 중단한다는 맥락에 정확히 부합
❌ ③ graduate school — 대학원. 중단의 기간 표현이 아닌 특정 장소/기관
❌ ④ normal life — 정상적인 삶. 문맥상 중단 기간을 뜻하지 않고 '삶이 정상으로 돌아왔을 때'라는 조건절에 해당
det.tip: at least for the immediate future = 적어도 가까운 미래 동안은. 일시적 중단임을 강조

questions.passage: Dear Randy: I have greatly enjoyed my work as a literacy volunteer at your center for the past three years. I think I have received as much from the people I have worked with as I have given. It has been a gift to be able to make a difference in the lives of such wonderful people. Unfortunately, though, I will have to suspend my involvement at least for the immediate future. I am getting married this spring, and with the arrangement for that, my full-time job at the hospital, and plans for graduate school, I am overwhelmed. When my life returns to normal, I would love to come back. Thank you for giving me the chance to __________. Sincerely, Morgan Diamond
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① return — 돌아가다. '돌아갈 기회를 주셔서 감사'는 아직 중단하지 않은 상황과 모순
❌ ② suspend — 중단하다. '중단할 기회를 주셔서 감사'는 중단을 감사하는 어색한 의미
❌ ③ give — 주다. '줄 기회를 주셔서 감사'는 동어반복 구조로 어색
✅ ④ contribute — 기여하다. Thank you for giving me the chance to contribute = 기여할 기회를 주셔서 감사하다는 따뜻한 마무리
det.tip: contribute = 기여하다. 자원봉사자로서 센터와 사람들에게 긍정적 영향을 준다는 의미
